title: WorkerProtocolV1Common
description: Shared $defs for worker-protocol v1. Frozen — additive changes only after archive.

ProtocolVersion.description: Frozen wire identifier for v1. Locked per design D2.

IssueRef.description: Tracker-native issue identifier (e.g., LIN-123, owner/repo#42, internal-board UUID). Pattern rejects leading whitespace/control chars to keep dashboard, log, and R2-key derivation safe.

Capability.description: Examples: agent:codex, agent:opencode, tmux, git, os:darwin, arch:arm64

LeaseSec.description: Lease duration in seconds. Wire-level bound is 4 hours; per-team config may set lower limits. Server authoritative; worker echoes for diagnostics only.

ConfigHash.description: Bare 64-char SHA-256 hex digest of the active workflow YAML. Content-addressable; safe in URL path parameters (no colon).

GitBranch.description: Git ref-name subset: rejects '..', leading dot per segment, '.lock' suffix, and trailing '.' or '/'.

error.description: Stable error code (snake_case). Per-endpoint enums in their own files.

ErrorResponseBase.description: Generic error envelope. Per-endpoint files define concrete error response schemas with additionalProperties: false and any structured fields the spec calls out (e.g., supported, max_events, max_bytes).
